brand brain: the brand's and competitors' recent organic posts and the competitor set (research-competitors / server)

persona — who a creator's followers must match (research-market)
campaign record: a campaign brief that calls for a creator leg (plan-campaign)
workspace creators/roster.csv via outcomes-ledger, earlier wave-1.md and briefs (this playbook); research/credits-log/<YYYY-MM>.md (spend-gate)
human: goal, budget, creators in talks, target CAC / CPA / planned media, cost per demo or install, roster status and wave results

workspace creators/<date>/summary.md, wave-1.md, near-misses.csv, briefs/<handle>.md (brief + first-message drafts) — read by the human, who sends and negotiates; wave-1.md read back on the next run
workspace creators/roster-summary.md → brand document 'Creator roster — <Brand> — <date>' (supersede; no contact details) — read by later runs and plan-campaign
